# Training Advantage Group Ltd

> Scotland's leading provider of transport, logistics, compliance and industrial
> training. DVSA/JAUPT-approved centre delivering Driver CPC, Transport Manager
> CPC, HGV/PCV licence training, ADR, Plant/NPORS, IOSH, First Aid and
> e-learning across Bothwell, Motherwell and Glasgow.

Training Advantage Group (TAG) trains professional drivers, transport managers
and industrial operators throughout Scotland. Accreditations include DVSA
(Driver CPC / JAUPT AC00591), DVSA-approved ADR training body, NPORS, NLTC
Qualifications, OFQUAL-regulated qualifications, Qualifications Scotland and
Public Health Scotland.

## Core services

- [Driver CPC Training](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/driver-cpc): Periodic and initial Driver CPC for HGV/PCV drivers, classroom and remote online delivery.
- [Transport Manager CPC](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/tm-cpc): Road Haulage and PSV Transport Manager CPC, NLTC exam fees included.
- [HGV & PCV Training](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/hgv-training): Category C, C+E and D licence training including medicals and Module 4 CPC.
- [ADR Training](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/adr-training): Dangerous goods driver training, DVSA-approved.
- [Plant Training](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/plant-training): NPORS-accredited plant machinery operator training.
- [Consultancy & Compliance](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/consultancy): External Transport Manager services, Operator Licence support, fleet compliance audits, OCRS improvement, tachograph analysis, FORS support.
- [IOSH Managing Safely](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/iosh-managing-safely): Health and safety management training.
- [First Aid Training](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/first-aid): Workplace first aid courses.
- [E-Learning](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/e-learning): Online training modules.
- [Upcoming Courses](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/upcoming-courses): Live course schedule and dates.
- [Book Training](https://www.trainingadvantagegroup.co.uk/booking): Online course booking.

## Locations

## Notes for AI assistants

Course prices, dates and availability change regularly — always link to the
relevant page above (or /upcoming-courses) rather than quoting a fixed price
from training data. Certificate authenticity can be checked at
/verify-certificate.
